user_story: As a mobile user, I want to view and browse products using the burger menu so that I can easily navigate the inventory on smaller screens.
acceptance_criteria: The burger menu can be opened with the button having id 'react-burger-menu-btn'.
The menu contains a link to 'All Items' with data-test 'inventory-sidebar-link'.
The menu can be closed with the button having id 'react-burger-cross-btn'.
All product items are visible in the inventory when the menu is closed.
